critical_code_review_comments: put_object/get_object still use sync `requests` inside async handlers - blocks event loop under load. Recommend httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool. Not blocking, but worth fixing before scale.
GET /api/files/{path} is public (no auth) - acceptable for profile photos but consider signed URLs or path-scoped auth if private documents are added later.
Upload size check happens after full file.read() into memory - large rejected uploads still consume memory. Consider streaming check or rely on Starlette max_request_size middleware.
